en: The postcard features a black-and-white image of a large villa-style house (named 'Villa Anna') nestled at the edge of a forested hill. In the foreground, a dirt road runs by the property, lined with young trees and a wooden fence. Several people and a horse-drawn carriage are visible along the road and in front of the house. At the top, there is German text in red and further information in small print at the bottom left.
